title: Verify reference fidelity of the existing MUAC age-boundary PR
problem: Existing PR #3626 revises patient-chart MUAC color comparisons and cites a national guideline after reviewer feedback. Source fidelity, caller age precision and remaining test gaps need independent verification; no remaining defect is claimed yet.
humanitarian_relevance: Patient-chart displays support clinical workflows. Faithful rendering of an agreed specification could reduce review uncertainty; no patient harm or realized benefit is established.

evidence.claim: PR author reports correcting missing age-boundary colors and later revising brackets/cutoffs using the Uganda Ministry of Health January 2016 guideline after review.

Current two-file diff changes getMuacColorCode and adds four expected-color tests. An earlier automated review criticized weaker assertions at an older commit; those comments must not be repeated as current findings.

code_surface: PR head e917f0c3f9140e1734313e414f6f96dec361087f: packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/vitals-biometrics-form.utils.ts and matching .test.ts; exact caller age calculation and configuration remain to inspect.
proposed_change: Support the existing PR with bounded verification if useful and welcome. Compare current code and tests to the PR reference, preserving author ownership; do not propose a competing fix or infer clinical standards for every deployment.
research_next_step: Finish AI/contribution-policy review and current PR feedback; visually inspect the cited guideline table and trace exact utility/caller age handling. Identify any unresolved reference-fidelity question before auditing setup and running synthetic original-code tests.
priority_rationale: Select verification support for an existing care-display correction over duplicating one of 79 open PRs. Source-backed uncertainty reduction is the candidate benefit; acceptance and clinical impact remain unproven.
tests: No target tests run. Inspected current PR diff and prior automated comment; full revised source, reference table, caller and test environment still require verification.
environment: TypeScript/React patient-chart monorepo. README describes Yarn/Turbo unit tests and Playwright; manifest, lockfile, scripts, deployment and isolated runner audit not yet complete. No installation, clone or service start.
maintainer: Existing PR belongs to its current author and cites reviewer feedback. No Humanifest outreach, scope agreement or review commitment.
risks: Clinical-reference fidelity is not proof of clinical validity across deployments. The 2016 Uganda guideline may not be current or applicable everywhere. Avoid stale review feedback, duplicate patches and patient data; AI eligibility and full setup remain unresolved.
